adLabelVersion.description: Ad label version; non-zero when the post is a sponsored ad
adLabelVersion.title: Ad Label Version

aiContentLabel.description: Which AI label TikTok shows: 'creatorLabeled' (Creator labeled as AI-generated) or 'aiGeneratedMedia' (Contains AI-generated media)
aiContentLabel.title: AI label

author.description: Author/creator information at time of scraping
author.title: Author

caption.description: Post caption/description text including hashtags and mentions
caption.title: Caption

captionMentionsHandle.description: True when the caption contains the text @handle of the tracked account
captionMentionsHandle.title: Caption types @handle

collectCount.description: Number of times post was bookmarked/collected
collectCount.title: Collect Count

createTime.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the post was created
createTime.title: Create Time (Unix)

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime when the post was created
createdAt.title: Created At

downloadedVideoUrl.description: Permanent link to the video file saved in this run's storage (only when 'Save video files' is on)
downloadedVideoUrl.title: Saved video file

duetEnabled.description: Whether the creator allows duets with this video
duetEnabled.title: Duet Enabled

forFriend.description: Whether the post is restricted to friends only
forFriend.title: For Friend

foundVia.description: 'search' = returned by TikTok search; 'relatedVideos' = found in the related videos of a post that tags the account
foundVia.title: Found via

hashtags.description: Hashtags used in the post caption
hashtags.title: Hashtags

isAd.description: Whether this post is a paid advertisement
isAd.title: Is Ad

isAigc.description: True when TikTok shows an AI-generated label on the post (creator-labeled or detected)
isAigc.title: Is AI Generated Content

isECVideo.description: Shopping video flag, when TikTok reports it for the post
isECVideo.title: Is E-Commerce Video

isOwnPost.description: True when the tracked account published the post itself
isOwnPost.title: Posted by the tracked account

isPaidPartnership.description: True when TikTok shows the 'Paid partnership' label on the post
isPaidPartnership.title: Paid partnership

locationCreated.description: ISO country code where the post was created (e.g. 'US', 'BR'); only when 'Add the country each post was made in' is on
locationCreated.title: Post country

mediaUrlExpiresAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime when signed media URLs (video/cover) expire
mediaUrlExpiresAt.title: Media URL Expires At

mentionEntry.description: The tag that points at the tracked account (tagged posts only)

displayText.title: Text shown in the caption (often the display name, e.g. @Gymshark)

start.title: Start position in caption (UTF-16 units, as in JavaScript)

mentionEntry.title: Matching tag

mentionType.description: Why the post matched: 'tagged' (caption contains TikTok's clickable tag of the account), 'captionText' (caption types @handle without a working tag) or 'searchResult' (returned by TikTok search for the handle, account not named in the caption)
mentionType.title: Mention type

mentions.description: Every account tagged in the caption
mentions.title: All tags in the caption

originalItem.description: Whether this post is an original (non-duet, non-stitch) creation
originalItem.title: Original Item

poi.description: TikTok place attached to the post (name, address, city, country, category), when the creator added one
poi.title: Location tag

postId.description: TikTok's unique post/video ID (string to preserve 64-bit precision)
postId.title: Post ID

postUrl.description: Link to the post on TikTok (/video/ for videos, /photo/ for slideshows)
postUrl.title: Post URL

privateItem.description: Whether the post is set to private
privateItem.title: Private Item

rank.description: 0-based order in which the post was first found for this account across all searches
rank.title: Rank

relatedToPostId.description: For posts found via related videos: the post whose related list contained it
relatedToPostId.title: Related to post

searchCountry.description: Country the TikTok search ran from (only when 'Search from country' is set)
searchCountry.title: Searched from

searchQuery.description: The TikTok search text that first returned this post
searchQuery.title: Search that found it

searchUrl.description: Open the same TikTok search in a browser
searchUrl.title: Search link

shareEnabled.description: Whether sharing is enabled for this post
shareEnabled.title: Share Enabled

stitchEnabled.description: Whether the creator allows stitching this video
stitchEnabled.title: Stitch Enabled

targetDisplayName.description: Display name of the tracked account
targetDisplayName.title: Tracked account name

targetFollowerCount.description: Follower count of the tracked account at scrape time
targetFollowerCount.title: Tracked account followers

targetSecUid.description: TikTok's secure user ID of the tracked account
targetSecUid.title: Tracked account secUid

targetUserId.description: TikTok's numeric ID of the tracked account
targetUserId.title: Tracked account ID

targetUsername.description: Handle of the tracked account this post was found for (lowercase, without @)
targetUsername.title: Tracked account

targetVerified.description: Whether the tracked account has TikTok's verified badge
targetVerified.title: Tracked account verified

textLanguage.description: Detected language code of the caption text
textLanguage.title: Text Language

video.description: Video technical metadata and signed play/cover URLs

bitrateInfo.description: All available quality/bitrate variants with play URLs
bitrateInfo.title: Bitrate Info

volumeInfo.description: Audio loudness and peak level metadata
volumeInfo.title: Volume Info

video.title: Video

overview.description: Posts that tag or mention each tracked account, with the reason they matched.
overview.title: Mentions overview
